head: IvyPod turns your iPhone into a classic click-wheel music player
dek: IvyPod plays your Apple Music library through a wheel-based look of the music players of the past, with lighting and haptics. It was #33 among all paid apps on the UK App Store on 9 November.
details: It also has song recognition powered by Shazam, a clock-style weather app, a wheel camera, Activity rings, podcasts, photos and mini games. It costs $2.99 (£2.99) with no subscription or in-app purchases, by Jeremy Siegel, and needs iOS 18.
means: If you miss the old click wheel, this brings its look to your Apple Music library.
todo: You need Apple Music; find IvyPod in the App Store.
thumb_words: A CLICK WHEEL ON YOUR IPHONE
